entities.summary: John Metchie III is a Taiwanese-Canadian professional football wide receiver and kickoff returner for the Carolina Panthers of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Alabama Crimson Tide, winning the Jon Cornish Trophy twice prior to being selected by the Texans in the second round of the 2022 NFL draft. Metchie sat out his rookie season after being diagnosed with acute promyelocytic leukemia and returned to play in 2023.
